source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Run `nvsm show storage` and verify all storage information and every Status_Health value.
procedure_facts: Single five-minute read-only NVSM display after a generic source instruction to clear logs.
criteria_facts: All storage information correct and all storage Status_Health values OK.
missing_source_information: Supported NVSM platform/version, authoritative drive/controller/volume inventory and attribute/health expectations.

original_test_intent.statement: Use NVSM to enumerate all platform-managed storage objects and verify their identity, attributes and health against the approved server storage recipe.
must_preserve: All storage-related information and every applicable Status_Health, not a sample.
must_not_infer: That NVSM supports every white-box platform.
That aggregate `Status_Health=OK` proves device count/identity/configuration correctness.
That logs may be cleared before evidence collection.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 requires a compatible NVSM package, complete storage/path scope and specification, preserves logs and prohibits storage mutation.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2's test command itself embeds `sshpass` and disables host-key checking despite its own security rules. It also lacks explicit object-class coverage for drives, controllers and volumes, where each has distinct identities/health attributes.

related_records: Generic OS/NVMe inventory cannot substitute for NVSM-managed object health, but may corroborate completeness.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The source command remains the primary view; official NVSM documentation defines its storage object coverage, while the platform recipe defines expected objects.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Use an approved compatible NVSM locally or through a secure channel, preserve existing evidence, and reconcile all reported drives, controllers and volumes to the expected topology; health OK alone is not full acceptance.

conditions_present: Exact read-only command and five-minute activity.
missing: NVSM support/version, expected object inventory/attributes/health and secure execution channel.
provider: Platform/NVIDIA owner supplies supported NVSM recipe and expected storage map.
Lab owner supplies authorized channel/evidence path.
safe_read_only_work: Without installing or clearing logs, inventory existing NVSM version/support and OS/controller/drive/volume topology and preserve error logs.
prohibited_until_resolved: Package installation, log clearing, remediation, format/mount/reset/scrub, credential bypass or PASS.
closure_evidence: Supported NVSM manifest and expected drive/controller/volume matrix for the exact system.

revision_candidate.test_name: Verify NVSM Storage Inventory and Health
revision_candidate.purpose: Enumerate every NVSM-managed storage drive, controller and volume and verify its identity, configuration attributes and Status_State/Status_Health against the approved server storage recipe without changing storage state or deleting fault history.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: An NVIDIA platform and NVSM release explicitly supporting the exact server, controllers, drives and volumes; applicability must not be extrapolated to an unsupported white-box system.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All objects included by `nvsm show storage`, with explicit reconciliation of drives, controllers and volumes to the expected physical/logical map. One read-only five-minute collection; corroborating OS/controller inventory is used only to detect omissions.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Supported NVSM package/version or existing installation; exact SUT/controller/drive/volume/RAID recipe; expected serial/model/firmware/capacity/path/volume attributes and Status_State/Status_Health; NVSM monitoring policy including muted drives; read-only privilege; secure execution/evidence channel.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve current dmesg/storage/controller/BMC/SEL evidence and capture independent read-only controller/drive/volume topology. Verify NVSM version/support and monitoring policy, then run `nvsm show storage` through the approved channel and retain complete raw output/status. Parse every drive, controller and volume; reconcile counts and persistent identities to the recipe and corroborating inventory; compare each required attribute, Status_State and Status_Health and report missing, extra, muted or unsupported objects.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct supported host; NVSM installed or provisioned under separate approval; complete expected topology/attributes; no storage mutation; sufficient privilege/evidence storage.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Host/NVSM/platform/firmware versions; monitoring/mute policy; exact command/status/time; complete raw NVSM output; expected versus reported drive/controller/volume counts; serial/model/firmware/capacity/path/RAID/volume mappings; per-object Status_State/Status_Health; independent inventory reconciliation; alerts plus preserved dmesg/controller/BMC/SEL context; discrepancy list.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Approved storage BOM/topology/configuration and the supported NVSM health policy for the exact platform. Pass requires complete expected object coverage, correct required attributes, no unexpected/muted/unsupported objects, all applicable health/state values acceptable and no corroborating disqualifying fault.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not clear logs, install without approval, use embedded passwords or host-key bypass, run remediation, format/mount/unmount/reset/scrub, change RAID/LVM/DM, unmute/mute monitoring, ignore missing objects or treat aggregate OK as proof of correct inventory.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Approval is required to install/provision NVSM; platform owner supplies recipe and judges unsupported/muted objects or discrepancies. The already-approved read-only query itself needs no storage mutation approval.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Query, parsing and comparison are automatable; package provisioning and discrepancy disposition remain human-controlled.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No recovery for a verified read-only query. If NVSM attempts mutation, hangs or triggers device/path errors, terminate safely, preserve all evidence, verify storage/boot/RAID health through approved tools and escalate without clearing logs.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unsupported/wrong host or NVSM; ambiguous object scope; missing expected map; query not read-only; credential/host identity failure; truncated output; attempted remediation; device/path loss; incomplete drive/controller/volume evidence. Missing expected values stops PASS, not safe actual collection where NVSM is already installed.

identified_defects: V2 command contradicts its credential/host-key policy.
Aggregate storage output lacks explicit drive/controller/volume coverage contract.
Health OK can coexist with wrong/missing or monitoring-muted objects.
reason_for_change: Make the read-only query secure and ensure all managed storage object classes are proven complete, not merely healthy-looking.

new_technical_evidence.title: NVIDIA System Management User Guide 25.03 - Using the NVSM CLI
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Supported NVSM platforms and storage display semantics
new_technical_evidence.supports: `nvsm show storage` displays all storage-related information; related objects include drives, controllers and volumes with per-object state/health, and monitoring can be muted for specified drive slots.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Exact target-platform support and expected inventory remain owner-supplied.

removed_ambiguities: Defines all three storage object classes.
Separates correct inventory/configuration from health status.
Exposes muted/unsupported objects and independent completeness check.
Removes insecure transport from the command contract.
resolved_blockers: Missing NVSM/spec are provisionable prerequisites rather than inherent BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: Supported package and exact expected object map remain absent.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 removes V2's insecure execution contradiction and proves completeness across NVSM drives, controllers and volumes—including monitoring-muted objects—so an aggregate OK cannot hide a wrong or missing storage configuration.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator preserved all drives/controllers/volumes, separated health from correct inventory, exposed monitoring-muted objects, retained log history and rejected aggregate OK or missing spec as automatic BLOCKED.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 328 runs nvsm show storage and requires all information correct plus every health OK.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 preserves evidence but embeds unsafe SSH; V3 secures execution and defines full object coverage.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Existing NVSM may be queried read-only after support/scope checks; package installation and any storage mutation remain gated.
